title: Hanasato Minori — I'll Treasure It For Life!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Kohane
rows.Line:
Morning.
Morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
SpoJoy Park was so much fun yesterday.
My arms are actually a little sore from it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
It's hard not to throw your hardest for strike zone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That still doesn't explain how you ended up throwing into someone else's lane.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... If only there were a version that made it so you could do that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, look!
I brought that pen you guys gave me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're meeting as a group today to discuss some stream ideas, so I'll get to use it then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's so strange...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's just...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm surprised at myself for actually hanging out and exchanging gifts with friends like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you are?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought we really hit it off the first time we all talked.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The first time we talked? When was that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right after the entrance ceremony.
We were all in the classroom looking for our desks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You and Minori really saved me that time, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What?! I'm literally right in front of the teacher!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Thank goodness I'm towards the back.
This is nice. I can see the courtyard from here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Let's see... There should be a piece of paper with my name on it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Azusawa... Azusawa...
Why am I having so much trouble finding my desk...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is something wrong? Do you need help finding your desk?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes... Um, I can't seem to find the paper with my name on it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lemme help you! I already found my desk!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What's your name?
Oh, mine is Minori Hanasato! Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Kohane Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's okay. Just try to relax.
We are classmates after all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, Kohane Azusawa... Got it!
Oh, can you tell me how your last name's written?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, “azu” and...
Ahem. It's “azu” and “sawa”. The “azu” means “red bean”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, and “sawa” as in a little creek!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, “azusawa” is like a creek of red bean paste...?! That sounds so sweet and delicious!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Delicious?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry!
That's just what came to mind! I wasn't trying to tease you or anything!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just a little surprised. I'm used to people pointing out that I have a unique last name, but I've never heard anyone say that it sounds delicious before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
Wait, that's right! I have to help find your desk!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They should be in name order, so you might be off to one side towards the front...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you weren't joking. I'm not seeing your name anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Do you think it fell off and wandered away somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, maybe!
Let's try asking everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, everyone else...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahem! Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh...?! Wh-What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A sheet of paper that says “Kohane Azusawa” seems to have fallen off its desk! Do any of you see it?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Her name's written with the characters for “red bean” and “little creek”!
It sounds really sweet and delicious!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sweet and delicious, huh?
But I haven't seen any papers with that name on it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, hi...

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Hm? Are you talking to me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would you mind picking up your bag for a second?

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Oh, this sheet of paper...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's this, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...? Y-Yes! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Azusawa!
I left my bag on top of it by accident...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it's not your fault since it seems to have fallen off my desk on its own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm so glad we found it!
Thank you all for your help!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
U-Um... Thank you for finding it.
C-Can I ask for your name...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know too! I'm Minori Hanasato, by the way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shiho Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hinomori...
Again, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I remember now...
But I'm not sure that counts as an actual conversation.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course it does!
In my book, we were all friends after we'd introduced ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your bar for that seems a little low...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you've been willing to put up with someone like me for this long...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I really doubt we're gonna stop being friends anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sh-Shiho...!
Yeah! Friends foreveeer!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, personal space...!
Don't start acting like Saki on me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, this moment totally calls for a big hug!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
